annotations.title: Check whether a model can be used

description: Kingy Can I Use: whether a specific model can be used for a purpose, through a route (direct API, third-party provider or open weights), in a jurisdiction (US, Canada, EU, UK). Returns yes, conditional, no or unknown with availability, licence, contract and regulatory dimensions and sources. Not legal advice.
